records.quote: Corollary 1. Let X ~ MEG(eta, beta_1) and Y ~ MEG(eta, beta_2). If beta_2 > beta_1, then 1. X <=_HR Y and X <=_ST Y. 2. E(X^k) <= E(Y^k) for all k in Z+.

conclusion.direction: X <=_ST Y (F_X(x) >= F_Y(x) for all x); a moment inequality E(X^k) <= E(Y^k) is also printed

note: Corollary 1 prints two named orders (HR and ST); split into one record per order per spec rule 5. Pass B had bundled st inside the direction text.

records.quote: Corollary 2. Let X1 and X2 be two Poisson-MEG mixtures with cdfs H1(x; beta_1) and H2(x; beta_2) and hrfs h1 and h2, respectively. If beta_2 > beta_1 then 1. X1 <=_HR X2 and X1 <=_ST X2. 2. E(X1^k) <= E(X2^k), for k in Z+.
